spec.description: rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="softirq"}). H10 primary signal — CPU0 approaching 1.0 while others stay near 0 = saturation. Threshold line at 0.9.
spec.title: H10: CPU softirq% by CPU

spec.description: rate(node_softirqs_functions_total{type="NET_RX"}). Cross-check for the CPU softirq% panel. Needs --collector.softirqs.
spec.title: H10: NET_RX softirq deliveries/sec per CPU

spec.description: rate(node_interrupts_total{devices=~".*end0.*"}). Single-queue NIC pins all end0 IRQs to one CPU; this should structurally show one line > 0 and the rest at 0. Needs --collector.interrupts.
spec.title: H10: end0 hard IRQs/sec by CPU

spec.description: rate(node_netstat_TcpExt_TCPTimeouts). Each timeout = up to 120 s of RTO backoff. H9 primary.
spec.title: H9: TCPTimeouts/sec

spec.description: Healthy < 0.5 %; threshold line at 0.005.
spec.title: H9: Retransmit ratio (RetransSegs / OutSegs)

spec.description: TCPLostRetransmit and TCPSpuriousRTOs. Distinguishes real loss from spurious RTO detection.
spec.title: H9: Lost retransmits & spurious RTOs

spec.description: rate(node_network_receive/transmit_bytes_total{device="end0"}) * 8 / 1e6. Threshold at 90 Mbps (10 % shy of the 100 Mbps line).
spec.title: Sentinel: end0 throughput (Mbps) vs 100 Mbps line

spec.description: rate(node_network_receive_{drop,errs}_total{device="end0"}). Should stay flat at 0; any climb on the receive path reopens H2.
spec.title: Sentinel: end0 RX drops & errors (H2)

spec.description: node_nf_conntrack_entries / _limit. Should stay << 0.01 on a healthy runner; H3 fully refuted on riscv-runner-20.
spec.title: Sentinel: Conntrack utilisation (H3)

spec.description: rate(node_ethtool_irq_transmitted_path_in_lpi_mode_n). LPI being entered constantly mostly means link is idle; only interesting if a slow-run window correlates with a marked change. Needs --collector.ethtool.
spec.title: H7: EEE / LPI enter rate (fallback)

spec.description: rate(node_network_transmit_{drop,errs}_total{device="end0"}). Should stay flat at 0; any climb on the transmit path means egress trouble.
spec.title: Sentinel: end0 TX drops & errors

spec.description: raw_github_probe_seconds for the Fastly target, faceted by remote_ip. A specific Fastly IP cluster being slow while others are fast = H1 (POP steering).
spec.title: H1: raw.githubusercontent.com — download time by Fastly IP

spec.description: raw_github_probe_bytes_per_second for the Fastly target, faceted by remote_ip.
spec.title: H1: raw.githubusercontent.com — throughput by Fastly IP

spec.description: runner_dns_resolved_ip — info metric (1 per resolved IP). Shows which Fastly IPs each node sees over time. Cache-region flips show up as the set of IP lines changing.
spec.title: H1: DNS resolutions for raw.githubusercontent.com

spec.description: raw_github_probe_seconds for both targets. When Fastly sags but Cloudflare stays flat → H9 (path-specific). When both sag together → H5 (Scaleway WAN egress).
spec.title: H5: Probe download time — Fastly vs Cloudflare

spec.description: raw_github_probe_bytes_per_second for both targets. Same correlation logic as the time panel.
spec.title: H5: Probe throughput — Fastly vs Cloudflare

spec.description: rate(node_softirqs_functions_total{type="NET_TX"}). TX-side softirq pressure per CPU; pair with the NET_RX panel for the full softirq picture on the link.
spec.title: H10: NET_TX softirq deliveries/sec per CPU

spec.description: TCPSpuriousRTOs / TCPTimeouts. Close to 1.0 = most RTOs were spurious (network was fine, kernel was impatient — RTO-min tuning territory). Close to 0 = real loss.
spec.title: H9: Spurious-RTO ratio (spurious / total RTO)

spec.description: TCPSackRecovery + TCPRenoRecovery (fast recovery, cwnd preserved) vs TCPTimeouts (RTO, cwnd collapsed). Healthy: fast dominates. Degraded: RTO dominates → severe / bursty loss.
spec.title: H9: Fast recovery vs RTO

spec.description: node_softnet_dropped_total and _times_squeezed_total per CPU. squeezed > 0 on the CPU handling end0 IRQs = NAPI poll exhausted its budget; the NIC then drops at the ring buffer before TCP sees it. Connects H10 (softirq saturation) to H9 (downstream TCP timeouts).
spec.title: H10: softnet drops & NAPI squeezes per CPU
H1 — Bad Fastly POP / IPv6 path
